profile.name: Neeraj Kumar
profile.role: I am learning to build systems that stay understandable as they grow.
profile.introduction: My current focus is the backend: APIs, data, reliability, and the decisions that connect them. I learn by turning those ideas into small, working products.
bio: I care about the parts of software people do not always see: clear boundaries, predictable failure modes, useful logs, and data models that make the next change easier.
This portfolio is also a systems exercise. Its content is designed to live outside the frontend, so the site can evolve without every copy change becoming a code deployment.

projects.title: Apex Rush
projects.summary: A procedural 3D arcade racer built as a focused browser prototype.
projects.description: A 2.4 km sunset sprint with AI rivals, nitro, collision response, a responsive race HUD, and keyboard or touch controls. The world is generated in code without external 3D models.
highlights: Procedural track, cars, scenery, particles, and lighting
Three rubber-banded AI drivers with lane changes

connect.heading: Let’s talk about useful systems.
connect.message: If you are building a backend-heavy product, exploring system design, or have feedback on my work, GitHub is the best place to find me right now.
